reviews.text: Ayla, was a phenomenal trainer. She was very patient with us as newly ly adopted parents of our dog. She took us through his paces and helped us to understand the importance of positive reinforcement in the training process. Prestige dog training is an excellent source of dog training for any type of dog. We highly recommend them.

We did two private lessons with Ulysses and a week of board and train with prestige for our dog who has reactivity issues with sounds and guests coming over and for general obedience like walking and recall. Millie learned so much and has improved significantly! She walks so well now, we can do off leash confidently, and is much less reactive. Ulysses was very easy to work with and we could tell how much our dog loved him. We would recommend prestige dog training to anyone!

We’ve been working with Ulysses for a while now and can't say enough good things about him. Originally we just wanted our dog to stop pulling and have a decent recall. Now we're doing off leash work and things I never thought we'd be able to do with him. Ulysses is also just a dog person. Our dog absolutely loses it when he sees him and gets so excited to train!

Highly recommend Prestige.

I'm so grateful for Prestige Dog Training! We worked with Ulysses to help my dog Milo with reactivity, lunging and leash pulling. After just a few weeks, there's been significant progress in my dog's behavior and our walks are no longer stressful.

Ulysses is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and adept at analyzing dog behavior. Highly recommend!

I could not recommend a better training program!

Our dog Smudge was incredibly reactive to all dogs in all settings and after trying different training programs, we were truly at a loss until we found Prestige Dog Training. After 2 weeks of training, Smudge can confidently see and walk past dogs without any sort of reaction. Even on day 2 of training, they were able to integrate him into group play with other dogs which was beyond shocking to us. We have never seen him not react to a dog in the 4 years he has been with us so we knew he was getting the best training.

Ulysses and Brianna worked with us so closely and helped/taught Smudge and us so much during these two weeks. They are so caring and so knowledgeable and Smudge loves working with them. They even continue to offer support to us even though our two weeks are over. Smudge is truly a changed dog and it's all thanks to the team at Prestige!

We had a great experience with Prestige Dog Training and Adonis. He did an amazing job with Oliver, and the entire process was seamless from start to finish. They took great care of him throughout the training, and we could really see the progress when he came home. Oliver is doing great and has learned so much. Of course, we’ll need to continue reinforcing everything at home and may do a couple of additional training sessions in the future, but we’re extremely happy with the results. Adonis was great to work with, and we would definitely recommend him and Prestige Dog Training!

Our dog, Suki, has struggled with reactivity and anxiety, but Ulysses made the training process so simple. He has an incredibly positive approach, and we’ve already noticed a difference in her behavior. We would highly recommend him to anyone!
Ulysses really helped learn how to train our puppy effectively! We were able to correct some quirks and learn how to instill good behaviors.

Brought my puppy in at about 6 months old for the 2 week board and train. He worked with Adonis and I am so incredibly impressed by the progress. My puppy was CHAOTIC going into it and we haven’t even been home for a day but I’m mind blown with how much he’s improved. He’s truly a different dog in the best way. Would give 10 stars if I could! Definitely recommend.

Adonis did a great job with our dutchie. He went into training quite reactive, when we picked him up after board and train it was like a new dog. He helped in all the aspects we wanted to change, I highly recommend the training!

Ulysses and Brianna are incredible. My german shepherd is a big nervous boy who recently got bit by another dog, which made things a bit worse — barking at dogs and even people across the street..

We are so grateful we found this team. They’ve patiently helped him build his confidence back up, and now we’re able to hang out at the dog beach, and even bring him to farmers markets!

They’re a small team, but are so knowledgeable, caring, and clearly invested in every dog they work with 💕

From a worried dog mom, your fur-baby will be in great hands!

Ulysses at prestige was a savior to my husband and I in training our fear based aggressive dog. After several other programs with no change, we saw immediate differences in our pup from the tools and guidance Ulysses gave us. He is highly skilled and knowledgeable trainer and we are so grateful we were able to work with him!

Ulysses and prestige are the best dog trainers you can get, and I have had a few of them so far. He acutely diagnosed our dogs fearfulness, and put us on a plan to work on a in-home behavioral modification program.  Our dog made such great progress over the few lessons, from not being able to tolerate a guest over to essentially taking a nap while guests are over. Ulysses gives you the tools and confidence to take on any training needs.

Can’t say enough good things about Ulysses and Prestige. Ulysses has worked with my dog (mali-mix) for over a year with everything from obedience to reactivity and my dog has made incredible progress. He’s knowledgeable and gives you the tools to know how to communicate with your dog. Has always been easy to get ahold of and willing to make your schedule work with his.

We are so thankful that we found Prestige!!! We just moved into an apartment from a house with our little dogs and we needed to get them to stop barking. The minute we started to train at home with Ulysses we saw a big difference!! Now we are no longer the apartment with the two loud barking dogs, just the apartment with the two cute dogs!

We signed up for the 4-session package with Ulysses at Prestige Dog Training to help our dog with reactivity, pulling, and overall obedience, and it has been a great experience!

Ulysses is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and hands-on. He takes the time to explain why our dog behaves the way he does and how each training technique helps address the issue, which has made a huge difference for us as owners.

We’ve already seen great progress and really appreciate how much he cares about the dogs he works with. I would highly recommend Ulysses and Prestige to anyone looking for quality dog training!

Ulysses is amazing to work with! He’s an absolutely lovely trainer and he truly understands dogs, their behaviours, and needs. I cannot recommend him enough - our puppy is so well behaved and I owe all of it to him.

I’m so thankful for Prestige! My dog became reactive after being attacked twice and we really wanted to get him back socialized and they did not only that but were able to get him in daycare with groups of pups! Would highly recommend!
Ulysses is very accommodating of my schedule and my pup. The sessions are very unique and tailored to my dog's needs. He loves coming back each time!
Adonis was AMAZING! We are thrilled with how our puppy came home after 2 weeks at prestige. Highly recommend, such friendly and caring staff.

We sent our pup, Harry, to Adonis and Ulysses at Prestige to their 2-week board and train program to work on Harry’s confidence and comfort being outside and walking. The team at Prestige is super professional, sends daily updates on areas they covered and photos. Prestige utilizes positive reinforcement techniques and training approaches. Harry left with more confidence on a leash, better at not greeting every person or other dogs on walks! Could not recommend Prestige enough!

Ulysses was so patient and knowledgeable!  He really took the time to listen, understand and respond with appropriate lessons to not only improve my dogs behavior, but my reaction to his behavior.  He really zeroed in on what we were trying to accomplish and we were able to meet/exceed these expectations in only two visits!  A truly amazing service which has forever changed my relationship with my dog for the better.  I would encourage every dog parent to invest in these lessons.  It’s more than worth it!

Ulysses is an excellent dog trainer! We have taken our 1 year old Rhodesian Ridgeback puppy to him for six one-on-one classes so far and we leave each class with clear training instructions that have paid off greatly. Ulysses gets to know you, your dog, and what you are looking to achieve with training instead of a 'one size fits all' approach. We will be back for more classes and highly recommend Ulysses to anyone who is looking for a trainer.

We have done private lessons with Ulysses, as well as dog training at the facility. He has been soo awesome with our pup Aiko - she started when she was 12 weeks old and by 16 weeks we were really able to tell the difference. She is much calmer and has learned the commands that they taught her! Thank you!!

I had such a great experience working with Brianna and wanted to share how much of a difference she’s made for me and my dog, Brownie. Since coming home, Brownie has shown amazing progress with his training. He genuinely seems happier, more relaxed, and more confident overall.

One of the biggest changes has been with walking him. This used to be something I really struggled with, but now it’s honestly been such a breeze. Walks feel calm and enjoyable instead of stressful, which is something I didn’t think would happen so quickly.

I really appreciate how patient, knowledgeable, and supportive Brianna has been throughout the process. She has a way of becoming best friends with dogs, and it’s clear she truly cares about both them and their owners, and that made the whole experience even better.

We have had such an amazing experience working with Ulysses and Prestige. He has helped us in so many ways as we train our new puppy and help our senior dog adjust to the new situation. Ulysses is patient, incredibly knowledgeable, and so talented in working with our pup. Thanks to him our dog has made incredible progress. As she has grown and new issues arise, he has helped build off the foundational skills so that we’re able to continually make progress. If you want an amazing training experience with a top notch trainer, call Prestige. Your dog will be set for success.

My dog came home a calmer, more confident version of himself after two weeks of board and train focused on reactivity. The progress was real and noticeable. The trainers kept me in the loop throughout, answered all my questions, and earned the trust of a dog who doesn’t give it easily. Kind, professional, and genuinely passionate about what they do. Worth every penny!

If you’re on the fence about doing a board-and-train program, I truly can’t recommend it enough. Adonis was incredible with our high-energy 5-month-old puppy, Winston. Before training, we were struggling with puppy biting, leash walking, and jumping on counters - so much so that Winston had been surrendered by another family because of the biting.

After just two weeks with Prestige, I’m honestly amazed at the strong foundation they’ve built for us to continue at home. Adonis kept us updated the entire time and sent the best photos while we were missing him, which meant a lot. He was also so approachable and made it easy for us to learn how to reinforce the training ourselves.

It was obvious how much Winston loved working with Adonis, and it gave us peace of mind knowing that when he wasn’t training, he was playing and socializing with other dogs in daycare.

This was truly one of the best decisions we’ve made for Winston and our future as a family. We’re so grateful to Prestige and especially Adonis for all their time, care, and patience in answering every single one of our questions. Highly recommend!
Great teacher and dog trainer. Goes beyond just training your dog himself. He teaches you how to train your dog so you can apply that knowledge to skills in the future.

We worked with Ulysses to help our 1 yr old Australian Shepherd that had become reactive to other dogs.  Ulysses had our dog improving immediately and in great shape within two weeks.  Our pup was previously isolated at daycare prior to neutering which resulted in aggressive reactivity we were struggling to correct.  We received great guidance on how to work with our pup in our home environment while Ulysses continued to build a strong base for us to work with. We are extremely happy with the results and cannot recommend Prestige and Ulysses enough.  It was worth every penny and more.

Ulysses is a fantastic dog trainer!  Our 8 month old black lab Playa has had 8 obedience classes, and she’s now so easy to be around!  She was potty-trained more quickly than we expected. She stopped biting people and everything else in sight. She heels consistently and walks right next to us, sits, comes to us when called, and gets on and off furniture that we point at.

I strongly recommend Prestige Dog Trainers!

Ulysses and the board and train program far exceeded our expectations!! We were at our wits end with our dog, Kevin. He got kicked out of daycare, wasn’t listening, had terrible recall, and got overexcited way too easily. On top of that, we were combining households and about to start introducing him to cats, which terrified us. The 3 week behavior modification board and train was nothing short of transformative. Kevin is a new dog. We can take him off leash at the park now. He is better socialized with other dogs. And, Ulysses even worked to familiarize Kevin with his cat. We would hands down recommend the program.

We had an amazing experience with Prestige Training! Lux had the best time during his board and train, he did well with everyone he worked with and made so many furry friends along the way. He did extremely well in his pickup class with all of his commands he learned over the three weeks he was there. The team was incredibly helpful throughout the entire process and always communicated clearly when scheduling visits, plus we loved receiving photos and videos of Lux along the way. We couldn’t be happier with the results!

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Prestige Dog Training, especially working with Ulysses. He has been incredible with our chocolate Lab, Kahlúa. From the very beginning, he took the time to understand her personality and meet her exactly where she was, which made such a difference in her progress and confidence.

Ulysses has helped us tremendously with leash work, e-collar training, and addressing behaviors like counter surfing and jumping. He explains everything so clearly and makes sure we understand not just what to do, but why it works. He is absolutely an expert and is incredibly knowledgeable about dog behavior, training techniques, and how to tailor his approach to each individual dog. He can answer every question we have and gives us practical, realistic tools that make a real difference in our daily life with Kahlúa.

What we appreciate most is how much he genuinely cares about her! It’s obvious he loves what he does and truly enjoys working with Kahlúa. He knows how to challenge her appropriately while still making her feel successful, and he always adjusts to her level. She gets excited when he comes over, and every private training session feels positive, productive, and encouraging for both her and us.

We’ve seen such meaningful improvement thanks to his guidance, and we feel so much more confident as owners because of him! We are looking forward to continuing our training as the weather warms up so we can work more outside and in public spaces. We highly recommend Prestige Dog Training and Ulysses to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely caring trainer!

We started working with Ulysses last summer for private lessons with our dog, Benny, and the progress has been incredible. Within just two months, Benny accomplished more than we had ever seen before. While training is always a work in progress, Ulysses was patient, down-to-earth, extremely knowledgeable, and very upfront about what to expect, which made the entire process feel realistic and encouraging. We’ve seen such positive changes thanks to his guidance, and I would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for a great dog trainer.

We recently enrolled our 1‑year‑old German Shepherd mix, Kip, in Prestige’s two‑week board‑and‑train program, and the results have been incredible. Kip used to lunge toward other dogs out of excitement, struggled with basic structure, and treated us like chew toys, but not anymore! He came home noticeably more focused, confident, and responsive. His everyday markers are solid, and walks have become enjoyable instead of stressful.
Huge thank‑you to Ulysses and the entire Prestige team for the amazing transformation. We couldn’t be happier and highly recommend them to anyone looking for real, lasting training results.
Awesome training! Very diligence and involved. Will be booking more.

Can’t thank Ulysses enough for his work with our dog. We had a lot of recall difficulty with our (notoriously stubborn breed) pup. After a few sessions with Ulysses, we can get him back from anywhere. Highly recommend and are so pleased with the training we received!

We couldn’t be happier with the experience Barley had at Prestige Dog Training! We needed somewhere for him to stay while we were away, and the fact that he could work on his puppy training at the same time through boarding Pet Care Plus was perfect.

Barley came home with new skills and improvement in his recall, loose leash walking, and basic commands. It’s clear they put in real time and effort with him, and they genuinely cared about his progress.

If you’re looking for quality training combined with excellent care, I highly recommend Prestige Dog Training.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had such a wonderful experience with Prestige Dog Training! Ulysses worked with our Goldendoodle, Roux, and the results have been amazing. Roux now waits and sits calmly at the door before going in, and he’s learned important commands like place, sit, and down, plus a few other helpful skills that have made our daily routine so much smoother.

Ulysses’ approach was professional, patient, and tailored to Roux’s personality. He gave us clear guidance and tools we can continue to use at home, which has made a huge difference in Roux’s behavior and confidence. We’re so grateful for the training and highly recommend Prestige Dog Training to anyone looking to build better habits and a stronger bond with their pup!

We did the board and train 3 week program for our 5 year old Australian Shepherd. We can’t thank Ulysses and Adonis enough for all the time they put into our dog. Our 5 year old Aussie named Link was a Covid puppy- unable to be around any people whatsoever, besides my husband and myself. All of his aggression/reactivity seemed to be anxiety and fear based. After the 3 week program, our dog is now able to take food from people- with little to no issue at all. We know it’s a work in progress but it has given us hope that Link’s issues can be managed with the right amount of training.

Thank you so much Ulysses, Adonis and Prestige!

We can’t thank Prestige and Ulysses enough for all the time and effort they spent working with our 1-year-old corgi, Casper. Casper came to the board-and-train program with reactivity issues and just general anxiety. He came back more confident, calmer, and ready to experience city life, and we now have less anxiety about taking him on walks and being out in public. Ulysses is truly amazing at what he does, and his follow-through and support are unmatched. This is the place to go if your dog has reactivity issues. Thank you, Prestige!

We sent our dog to Prestige for help with specific behavioral issues, including leash reactivity, and were very happy with the results. Even her daycare noticed the positive changes. Highly recommend!

Franca (my dog) and I have had a wonderful experience with Prestige - it’s the best decision I could have made as a dog owner. I’ve worked with Ulysses during one-on-one training sessions and in the context of a 2-week board and train. The one-on-one sessions were personalized to Franca’s specific needs and helped me understand 1) the rationale behind behavioral dog training and 2) how I can best support Franca. Franca also completed the 2-week obedience board and train. It was so nice having the peace of mind that she was well taken care of and had daily training while I was away on vacation. She came back her same energetic, loving, spunky self but with a whole set of tools and very good understanding of commands. She also absolutely adores Ulysses and gets so excited when she sees him, which was a good sign to me that she had a great time. All in all, after my training experience,  I feel like Franca and I can finally communicate with each other, which has been such a game changer. Walks are no longer stressful and it allowed me to really build structure and routine into our day to day. The best part is we keep working and building her skills and Ulysses is kind enough to respond to all my questions to make sure all the work we put in is maintained. I plan to continue working with Ulysses as Franca grows!
Ulysses was very reachable, accommodated my busy schedule and was great with my 6 month old puppy. Will be returning for future visits.

I can’t say enough good things about Prestige Dog Training and Ulysses Hagedorn. When I first moved into my new apartment, my dog Winston was struggling with anxiety and constant barking whenever I left. After doing my research and meeting with Ulysses, I immediately felt confident that Winston was in the right hands.

Winston completed the 4-week Masters Program, and the results have been nothing short of incredible. Ulysses’ communication throughout the entire process was exceptional — I always knew what Winston was working on, how he was progressing, and how I could continue reinforcing those lessons at home.

The transformation in Winston’s behavior has truly been priceless. He’s calmer, more confident, and finally at ease in our new environment. Ulysses not only trained Winston, but he also trained me to understand and support my dog better.

If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares, communicates clearly, and delivers real results, Ulysses and Prestige Dog Training are unmatched. I couldn’t recommend them more highly!
Thanks, Samuel! Glad you found our prices fair. See you and your pup again soon!

We recently got a 3-year old dog, Remy, from a shelter. He had issues with reactivity on walks, separation anxiety, questionable behavior around other dogs, and lacked certain key commands.
After some classes with Ulysses, Remy acts 10x better in every aspect! I could not have asked for better results. Highly recommend.

Our high energy, not quite two year old pup did a two week boarding/training with Prestige Dog Training and this has made a world of difference. Thunder already had a good grasp of sit but walking on a leash and recall were challenges that we struggled to master with him. After two weeks with Prestige, Thunder could consistently heel and come. Not only did Thunder learn new skills but Prestige helped us learn the necessary skills to maintain and continue to develop his training. We had a great experience!

Working with Ulysses on our husky's recall and humping behaviors was incredibly helpful! We are so grateful for his guidance, support, and resources. And working with Ulysses on our Bernese Mountain Dog rescue dog on her separation anxiety has been invaluable! We are thrilled with the progress both of our dogs have made and would work with Prestige Dog Training again in a heart beat.

Ulysses is a great dog trainer. Before training, my dog was reactive and having a hard time adapting to the busy and unpredictable environment that Chicago brings. Ulysses did an amazing job helping her become more comfortable and confident. He’s kind, attentive, and truly cares about each dog he works with. I really appreciated how he adapted his training methods to fit both my dog’s personality and my own comfort level as an owner. Thanks to him, walks and social situations are so much more enjoyable now!

Ulysses is PHENOMENAL! He is so knowledgeable, kind, and incredibly good at what he does. Our girls learned to curb their not so good behaviors thanks to Ulysses and his personalized approach. He gave us lots of really helpful skills and techniques rooted in animal behavioral science and also helped us implement those skills in real time so that we could be successful at home. Could not recommend him enough! Thank you, Ulysses!

I am happy that I chose Prestige Dog Training to assist me in training my puppy. The private training sessions had been very effective in disciplining my dog to potty indoors and outdoor. Uyless cares about dogs as they were his. I couldn’t find a XXS dog collar for my Morkie, and after my training session had ended at 5:00 pm, Uyless brought me a collar for my dog at 7:00 pm. I was so grateful for this kind gesture. If you’re looking for an effective dog trainer, I recommend Professional services of Prestige Dog Training Academy for training your dog you will not be disappointed.

I couldn’t be happier with my experience working with Ulysses. Ulysses was incredibly patient with me and able to answer any of my questions as a new dog parent. My puppy came home from his 2 week board and train more confident and well-behaved than ever. Ulysses clearly cares deeply about every dog. I’ve already brought my dog back for a second one week long board and training session after having such a good first experience!

As a first time dog parents Ulysses has made the process of training my puppy to be the well behaved dog he is easier than I could have ever expected. Can’t recommend him enough!

I have experienced the pure joy of adopting rescued labs.  Each rescue was enrolled in dog obedience classes, as required by the rescue organization.  My third rescued, lab, Charlotte, was adopted at 5 months of age.  After a full examination, my veterinarian assessed that Charlotte was very intelligent, and she stated Charlotte's success was dependent on me.  The training bar was raised several notches!  Enter Ulysses and Prestige Dog Training Academy private lessons.

Although I'm considered a seasoned dog owner, I was nervous about the training to reach the expectations set by my veterinarian and, also, to do right by Charlotte.  Dog training teaches the basic commands, ensuring your dog becomes a good canine citizen.  However, through Ulysses' training, I obtained a more in-depth awareness of my role as a dog owner, such as to be proactive rather than reactive and to think about what I wanted Charlotte to do and not so much to correct undesirable behavior.  I came to understand the "how" and "why" of dog behavior and learned that dogs are contextual and not stubborn or disobedient.  The key to effective dog training is communication and solutions based from kindness.

The Prestige Dog Training Academy philosophy is based on the ABC's of Operant Conditioning - Antecedent, Behavior, Consequence.  Armed with this knowledge, I have confidence on what to do in any situation and how to address or manage any behavior exhibited by Charlotte.

I'm active with civic and volunteer groups in my community and have received compliments from associates and colleagues that Charlotte is a calm, confident and well-mannered dog.

Private lessons with Charlotte started at my home but switched to Saturdays at the Prestige Dog Training Academy in Chicago due to my work schedule.  Colleagues were amazed that I traveled over 20 miles to continue Charlotte's training, but this reflects how much I valued our training sessions with Ulysses.  When you want the best, you will happily go the distance.

To define Ulysses as an expert dog trainer is accurate.  However, he provides so much more.  Upon meeting with Ulysses, you will recognize and appreciate the full depth and breadth of his knowledge and certified training on all things dog and animal behavior, as well as his passion and dedication to his profession.  Ulysses is confident, extremely patient and always calm as he provides a clear, consistent tailored training strategy for your dog and you.  Ulysses has the answer and solution for any type of dog behavior, dog personality quirk or any life situation with your dog.

Roger Caras wrote:  "Dogs are not our whole life, but they make our lives whole."  If you wish to enrich your relationship with your dog, optimize your dogs' intelligence and abilities, and experience consistent support and effective training, sign on with Ulysses and his qualified team at Prestige Dog Training Academy in Chicago.  it will be the best decision you'll ever make.

Thank you, Ulysses, for the time you invested with Charlotte and me.  With the strong foundation you've helped me to build for Charlotte, I'm confident we will reach our ultimate goal of being active in a service role within our community.

A proud moment today:  Charlotte achieved her AKC Canine Good Citizen Certification!
Great experience! Prestige is very responsive to questions and concerns. My dogs seem to have learned a great deal through this experience and I would definitely recommend them for training

Ulysses was fantastic, in just a few sessions he taught my 2 yr Aussie to heel, not react on walks, and stop barking. Plus, my dog sleeps better and has a happier, calmer demeanor now that he's trained. He enjoys walks much more and anytime he notices a dog, he doesn't react at all and stays by my side. Can't recommend it enough!!
Great place! I take my rambunctious boxer puppy here for training and socializing. Friendly staff and happy dogs everywhere.

We have worked with the Prestige team over almost five years with two dogs. They are very professional and caring toward our dogs and the dogs love them and always get a lot out of the experience in terms of improving their behavior and responsiveness to commands. I personally have spent upwards of a thousand hours training our dogs and competing them but sometimes you need the help of a pro and we have a lot of trust in this team.

We left Rosie, our 9-year old border collie mix, with Ulysses for a 3-week board and train session. Rosie had been having reactivity issues with other dogs in our building's hallways and elevators. We also wanted to be able to do more off-leash walking with her. We had never boarded a dog before (Rosie is our fourth), so we were nervous. We are happy to say that the experiment was a great success. Ulysses did great work with Rosie. She is more confident and much calmer now with other dogs. She is more responsive to commands. It's almost as if she became a younger, more vibrant and attentive version of herself. We are very grateful to Ulysses for all his care and attention.

We recently adopted a 6-year-old German Shepherd after a foster fail! She has the biggest heart but struggled with reactivity toward both dogs and unfamiliar people. After just a few private lessons with Ulysses, Florencia has made such great progress, she’s now much more tolerant of dogs and people on walks and has even gone so far as to make some friends.

I wasn’t sure with Florencia’s age and unknown history how much progress we would realistically make, but she has really turned a corner for the better and I am so grateful! Can’t recommend Ulysses enough, especially for reactive, anxious dogs!
Ulysses did a great job with our dog Milo. After a few sessions, his behavior improved dramatically. I would recommend him 100%.

Ulysses is an Incredible Dog Trainer — Truly Life-Changing

We seriously can’t thank Ulysses enough. Our dog Enzo went through his two-week board and train program, and it completely changed our lives and Enzo’s for the better.

Before training, Enzo was super anxious and constantly nipping at us. Not out of aggression, but because he was overwhelmed and didn’t know how to cope. We were stressed, he was stressed, and walks were a mess. After two weeks with Ulysses, he came back a totally different dog. He’s so much calmer, listens to us, heels on walks, and is just overall happier. Now he just wants cuddles and pets instead of using us as chew toys.

Honestly, we found Ulysses through Google reviews and thought, “there’s no way someone can be this good,” but he really is. If you're reading this and feel the same, trust me, it’s real.

What makes Ulysses stand out is how deeply he understands dog behavior. He doesn't just teach obedience commands — he gets to the root of why your dog is acting the way they are. He took the time to really understand Enzo’s specific issues and made sure we, as owners, felt confident keeping things going at home. He explains the theory in a way that makes sense and is super patient and supportive throughout the whole process.

If you're struggling with your pup and looking for a dog trainer who truly cares, Ulysses is 100% worth it. We’re so grateful and couldn’t recommend him more.

So, so glad we found Ulysses and Prestige Dog Training. I was struggling to find the right match to help out with my fully deaf, pitty mix. She was struggling with leash reactivity, pulling, not being a great walker, and general anxiety around other dogs. From the first session I knew Ulysses was going to be a great fit. He really takes the time to tailor each session to the dog’s needs.
He is beyond patient, and knowledgeable, and most importantly my dog LOVED him. She was very timid about the sessions at first, but by session 3 or 4, you could tell she finally built up that trust and was so excited to see him every week.

I was also super nervous to have her in doggy daycare and play groups after a bad experience at a dog park. But, by the end of our sessions we have now started to re-enter that type of socialization. I seriously didn’t think my dog would ever have the confidence to be in those environments again.

Can’t recommend Ulysses enough!!! He will make you and most importantly your dog feel beyond comfortable.

Thank you Prestige Dog Training!

We sent our dog to the Board and Train program at Prestige Dog Training and worked with Ulysses and wow, what a transformation.
Before training, our pup had zero impulse control, didn't listen, and was super reactive on walks. After just a few weeks with Ulysses, he came back a completely different dog.
Ulysses kept us updated the whole time, sent us progress videos, and made the transition back home so smooth. He gave us the tools and confidence to maintain the training ourselves, and even followed up to make sure everything was still going well.
